name: CDVAE (Crystal Diffusion Variational Autoencoder)
one_liner: Periodic SE(3)-invariant variational autoencoder and Langevin dynamics generator whose latent optimization is guided by a learned property predictor.

loop.proposes: A periodic GNN decoder predicts unit-cell lattice parameters, stoichometry, and denoises atomic coordinates via annealed Langevin dynamics.
loop.judged_by: A learned property predictor guides latent optimization; validity checks (symmetry, bond distance, charge neutrality) and a separate learned energy model evaluate finished samples.
loop.steers: Gradient ascent in latent space steers sampling toward lower formation energy.

headline_result: Generated valid periodic crystal structures across carbon, perovskite, and Materials Project benchmarks with high structural and compositional validity.
caveat: Latent-space property optimization relies on a learned surrogate predictor.
beyond_harness_note: Uses a periodic SE(3)-equivariant diffusion VAE rather than an LLM, steered by a learned property predictor and evaluated with validity checks and a learned energy model.
algorithmic_authority: Crystallographic validity checker and a learned energy model

sources.title: Crystal Diffusion Variational Autoencoder for Periodic Material Generation (ICLR 2022)

verification.notes: Checked against Xie et al., ICLR 2022.
